title: Vertex workplace assistant — call scrapbook
body:
Meeting: Vertex (internal HR SaaS) discovery call — 2025-11-16
Attendees: Jordan Lee (Redwood), Maya R. (Redwood SE), Ethan C. (Redwood), L. Patel (Vertex Eng), N. Ortiz (Vertex PM), K. Summers (IT/Security)

Purpose: quick capture of requirements, gotchas, PoC scope and next-steps. This is a messy scratchpad — keep rough notes.

Context / customer summary:
- Vertex builds an internal 'workplace assistant' for employees: onboarding FAQ, policy search, PTO scheduling help, and Slack responder.
- Want tight data controls (SAML SSO, SCIM, optional on-premise data store), material data residency requirement for EU-only employee data.
- Priority is low-latency reply in Slack (sub-500ms median for short answers) and high accuracy on policy retrieval. Volume: ~2k daily active users, spikes up to 6k/day (all internal).
- Preference to avoid sending employee PII to 3rd-party models. Evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) or Dedicated depending on cost.

Customer asks / acceptance criteria for PoC:
- Demoable Slack flow that answers 80% of common HR FAQs (they will provide top-50 queries).
- Embeddings-backend for semantic search on their knowledge base (approx 30k docs, internal Confluence + PDFs).
- SSO integration (SAML) + audit logging of queries (who asked, timestamp) exported to their SIEM.
- Token accounting + rough cost estimate for steady-state 2k DAU.

Technical notes / integration points:
- Auth: they must use SAML SSO; also want user context (role) sent as metadata to Redwood so policies can be filtered. Need guidance on headers vs tokenized claims.
- Data flow: Doc ingestion pipeline: Confluence export -> text normalization -> chunking -> embedding generation -> index. Confirm whether to do embedding generation inside Redwood Private (preferred) vs generating locally and pushing vectors.
- Embedding index choices discussed: customer leans away from external vector DB (managed) for compliance. Options: run Faiss inside VPC, or Redwood-provided dedicated index (private). Action: propose two options with cost/delta.
- Latency: Slack expects fast responses. Plan: use cached top-N answers (prefix caching) for top-50 queries, and embeddings similarity search for fallback. Consider synchronous reranking model vs hybrid rerank.
- Rate limits and bursts: expected spikes tied to town-hall events. Need autoscaling profile for Dedicated tiers.

Prompting / evals (scratch):
- Retrieval prompt skeleton: "You are Vertex's internal HR assistant. Use the provided context to answer concisely. If no answer in context, say 'I don't have that info, please contact HR@vertex.com'."
- Reranker candidate temperature: 0.0 for deterministic ranking. Use a short instruct-tuned model for final rewrite.
- Example prompt pair (for their top-50):
  Q: "How do I enroll in parental leave?"
  Retrieval context: [policy chunk]
  Expected: short bullets with link to policy doc, eligibility table, contact.

Privacy / security constraints:
- EU data residency: employee records for EU employees must stay in EU region. Redwood Private in EU preferred.
- Audit log retention: Vertex wants query logs stored 2 years. Need to confirm whether logs contain embeddings or only metadata.
- PII: request to redact sensitive fields before sending to model. Suggest using local pre-processing redaction (Regex + small entity filter).

Riskiest assumptions / unknowns:
1) Can we meet responsiveness objective (sub-500ms median) while doing online embedding search + model response in Private deployment? Need micro-benchmark with 30k index.
2) Whether Vertex will accept Redwood-hosted index inside their VPC or insist on customer-managed Faiss.
3) How much of their Confluence content is images/attachments (OCR costs/time).

Quick back-of-envelope cost signals (very rough):
- Embedding generation 30k docs x 5 chunks ~150k embeddings. One-time cost magnitude: moderate. Ongoing: ~daily doc churn small.
- Inference: 2k DAU, avg 1.6 queries/user/day => ~3.2k queries/day. If average response = 150 tokens, estimate tokens/month ~ 14M. Model choice influences cost heavily.

Architecture options (high-level):
A) Redwood Private (VPC) with customer-managed Faiss inside the VPC + Redwood inference nodes in EU region. Pros: maximal control. Cons: more ops for customer.
B) Redwood Dedicated with private index (Redwood-managed but in EU cluster) + audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. Pros: less ops, easier scaling. Cons: slightly less control, contractual.
C) Hybrid: embedding gen and index in customer infra, inference in Redwood Dedicated. Lowers data egress but adds infra ops.

PoC proposal (suggested scope): 4-week PoC
- Week 0: alignment call + NDA + access to top-50 queries and sample Confluence export. (Owner: Vertex PM)
- Week 1: small ingest + build index (Demo: live search in console), SAML test account created. (Owner: Jordan + Vertex Eng)
- Week 2: Slack integration + quick reply flow, caching of top-50. (Owner: Maya)
- Week 3: Evaluation + tweak prompts + audit logging config. Internal dry-run with 50 employees. (Owner: Ethan + Vertex Ops)
- Week 4: Handoff + cost estimate + decision doc.

Concrete next steps (short):
- Jordan: send PoC SOW draft + rough budget (due: 2025-11-20).
- Maya: sample prompts + retrieval prompt template (due: 2025-11-21).
- Ethan: prototype ingestion script for Confluence -> chunked JSON (due: 2025-11-24).
- Vertex: provide top-50 queries + sample Confluence export (Due: 2025-11-19).
- Security: K. Summers to confirm SIEM ingestion format and retention constraints (Blocker until answered).

Unresolved questions to triage in follow-up:
- Do they require model weights to be fully air-gapped for EU employees? (if yes, causes big change)
- Acceptance criteria for accuracy / fallback rates (what % of 'I don't know' is tolerable)
- Do they want to persist conversation history beyond immediate session? For compliance, retention time matters.

Notes from Slack thread after call:
- Vertex mentions potential pilot budget ~ $25k for PoC (will confirm).
- They prefer a canary rollout to HR org only initially.

Random scribbles / low-priority ideas:
- Consider a small client-side helper to mask PII before sending to embeddings (runs as lambda in their VPC).
- Precompute embeddings nightly to limit burst embedding generation during spikes.
- Add a short eval harness: 200 labeled Q/A from top-50 to measure semantic retrieval recall@5 and generation ROUGE-ish metric.

Reference links (for follow-up):
- Confluence export guide: CONF-vertex-knowledge-base-setup
- Previous similar PoC with "Aster Labs" (internal doc link in CONF) — reuse ingestion recipe.

Status: hold for Vertex to share top-50 sample and confirm SAML test account.

-- end of scrap notes (will clean into a PoC SOW once Vertex confirms budget)
